text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-gateway.prod.ap-southeast-1 - 5xx-rate > 6% over 2m window. Alert: PD#INC-8421. Link: https://pd.example/INC-8421

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty notification sent to @oncall-rotation (sre-sam).

sre-sam: acked. I'm on it. Looking at metrics now.

ingrid: seeing 502 and 504 primarily, small % 500s. 99th latency also spiked.

maria: any customer-facing errors? CX dashboard shows spike in RT complaints for token-generation endpoints.

leo: stack: inference-gateway -> knative-routing -> model-sidecars (gpu)

sre-sam: running quick tails. `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-gateway -c proxy --since=2m | tail -n 200`

sre-sam: excerpts: 
```
2026-02-14T03:12:11Z ERR upstream_resp_status=502 path=/v1/generate model=my-open-model worker=worker-42 msg="upstream connection reset"
2026-02-14T03:12:14Z ERR upstream_resp_status=504 path=/v1/chat model=redwood-xl worker=worker-10 msg="deadline exceeded"
```

ingrid: model-sidecar logs show repeated `kv cache miss` leading to longer tail latencies on first requests. spikes align with traffic bursts to /v1/generate.

maria: could be a cascading cold-start + prefix cache storm. Did we push a config change?

leo: deploybot: No active deploys in last 30m. I just checked CI pipeline.

sre-sam: paging state: PD auto-escalation scheduled in 4m if not acknowledged by secondary oncall. Currently acked by primary.

pagerduty-bot: Note: alert suppression attempted for flapping rule; suppression did not apply because threshold reset.

ingrid: trying targeted mitigation: temporarily route traffic away from ap-southeast pool to eu-west1 pool for non-region-bound requests. Running traffic-shift CLI: `redwood route set --from ap-southeast-1 --to eu-west-1 --weight 0.6 --path /v1/generate`

maria: :thumbsup: also triggering KV cache warmup on eu-west replicas to avoid cold jump. `curl -X POST https://ops.example/cache/warmup?model=redwood-xl` (internal)

sre-sam: applied route shift, starting to see drop in 5xx in ap-southeast after ~30s. Metrics: 5xx-rate ap-southeast now 3.2% down from 6.1%.

leo: note: we have a rate-limited burst on some clients (mobile SDK) that bypass geo-routing. I'm adding a quick token bucket rule to drop excessive new sessions: `envoy config update --limit 200/s` for gateway-ingress.

incident-bot: PD auto-escalation suppressed by manual ack from sre-sam.

maria: raising severity: customer-impact yes (degraded latency and errors for a subset of orgs in APAC). Escalating to SEs to notify top 10 customers.

sre-sam: rolling restart of worker pool in ap-southeast started: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker --namespace=inference --field-selector=region=ap-southeast`

ingrid: restart is causing brief reconnection errors but should reduce stuck KV states.

leo: I'm monitoring circuit breaker counts; they were high but refilling now.

sre-sam: update at +18m: ap-southeast 5xx-rate down to 1.1%, overall gateway latency trending back to normal. PD alert will be resolved if stable for next 5m.

maria: what caused suppression mismatch earlier? PD rule looked like it should suppress duplicate alerts for same signature. We need to check alert dedupe keys.

leo: filing follow-up ticket: INF-1742 to align PagerDuty dedupe keys with signature fields (include region + error-type + service).

sre-sam: oncall handoff in 40m to ingrid; I'll write runbook notes. Quick action list added to incident postmortem draft: 1) revisit cache warmup heuristics, 2) auto-shift thresholds, 3) PD dedupe + suppression tuning.

ingrid: copying notes. I'll take the next rotation. Please ping if it regresses.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-8421 acknowledged by sre-sam. Status: under investigation -> mitigation in progress.

sre-sam: resolving PD alert now — 5xx back within SLOs and customer retries reduced. Closing PD incident; will open postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8421: status changed to resolved by sre-sam. Duration: ~28m. Auto-log created: https://ops.example/incidents/INC-8421/log

maria: follow-up: outreach to top customers in APAC queued. I'll attach example message to the postmortem.

leo: thanks team. We'll track INF-1742 + PM follow-up.

ingrid: :white_check_mark: good recovery.

sre-sam: final note: disable aggressive promotion of cold-model replicas for now until warmup policy tuned.
